races.paceDynamic: Rosie Frith will lead this field uncontested from the start, given she's the only confirmed front runner among 11 runners. With multiple prominent runners like Tornado Kiss, Joyful Tidings, Allsortz, Treasured Royal, and Bay Of Supremacy likely to settle just behind, there'll be decent pace but not suicidal fractions. The hold-up contingent of Amiata, Bad Boy Rizz, Fox In Flight, and Soulful Diva will need Rosie Frith to maintain a genuine gallop to set things up. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can track the leader without getting embroiled in early pace battles and kick when the race develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Rosie Frith sets honest fractions and the prominent runners position perfectly behind her.
scenarios.body: The prominently-raced horses can track the leader comfortably before unleashing their finishing kicks, while hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the testing ground. This tactical positioning proves decisive over the sharp 5f trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If Rosie Frith goes too fast early or the prominent runners engage in pace battles behind her.
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainable, setting up the race perfectly for the closers who can pick up the pieces in the final furlong. Amiata and Fox In Flight benefit from their patient tactics as the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Rosie Frith Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the leader finds the perfect rhythm and the field allows her an easy time in front.
scenarios.body: Despite her lengthy absence, Rosie Frith capitalizes on uncontested fractions to build an unassailable advantage. The prominent and hold-up horses leave their runs too late on ground that's testing enough to blunt their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Rosie Frith breaks badly or refuses to take up the running from the start.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with no clear pace-setter, turning into a sprint from halfway. This chaotic scenario can produce a surprise result as tactical positioning becomes irrelevant and raw speed takes over.

watchPoints.text: Rosie Frith breaking slowly or being reluctant to lead would completely alter the pace dynamics and create chaos

Bad Boy Rizz and Amiata as the most likely hold-up winners if the early pace becomes too strong
David Marnane's three runners all face questions given his poor 0/12 recent strike rate
Bay Of Supremacy and Treasured Royal representing the two most in-form training operations in Murtagh and Cromwell

races.paceDynamic: Jordan Breeze will be the primary pace-setter from the front, with multiple prominent runners including Kilmood Susan, An Laochmor, Steel Magnolia, and Snowballs likely to track closely behind. This creates a competitive early tempo but not suicidal pressure, as the hold-up horses are numerous and will settle further back. The strong contingent of hold-up runners including Jered Maddox, Spirit Above, Windsor Lily, Mini Cotai, and Lady Landhort suggests the pace will be genuine enough to set up a late charge. This race shape clearly favours the hold-up brigade who can benefit from the sustained gallop and closing kick opportunity.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Jordan Breeze sets a genuine gallop and the prominent runners keep honest pressure
scenarios.body: The strong pace will perfectly set up the large contingent of closers who can unleash their finishing kicks. The hold-up horses have the class edge and tactical advantage in this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners control
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes more moderate with Jordan Breeze allowed an easy lead
scenarios.body: The prominent trackers can stay closer to the action and have enough left to repel the late challengers. Steel Magnolia and An Laochmor can use their tactical speed advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner steals it
scenarios.trigger: If Jordan Breeze gets loose on the lead with soft fractions early
scenarios.body: The 4-year-old can build an unassailable advantage before the field gets organized, using recent good form to maximum effect. The hold-up horses leave themselves too much to do.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Jordan Breeze sets pedestrian fractions and nobody applies pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl that turns into a pure sprint finish where any style can prevail. Form and class become secondary to who gets the best racing room.

races.paceDynamic: Dragon Of Malta appears the lone confirmed pace-setter, returning from a 192-day break but showing natural early speed. With most runners preferring to sit back (Gleneagle Bay, Usuario Amigo, Mallavelly, Goal Exceeded, Brewing all hold-up types), Dragon Of Malta should get an uncontested lead with minimal early pressure. The lack of pace pressure will create a sustainable tempo that allows front-runners and prominent racers to dictate terms, while the large contingent of hold-up horses will face the difficult task of making up ground in a slowly-run race. This race shape strongly favours horses that can race prominently or track the pace closely.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Dragon Of Malta gets an easy lead without early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace-setter controls the race from pillar to post, dictating fractions and keeping enough in reserve for the finish. The lack of pace pressure means hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground in time.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes overly steady and collapses in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The prominent racers tire from their efforts and the patient hold-up horses benefit from a sprint finish. Mallavelly and Gleneagle Bay can unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If L L Koulsty or Send Harry track Dragon Of Malta closely throughout
scenarios.body: The pace-tracking horses get first run on the leader while maintaining tactical position. Their proximity to the pace gives them the jump on the deeper hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Dragon Of Malta stops quickly after the long absence and the race becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: The entire field bunches up in the final two furlongs creating a blanket finish. Form and class become the deciding factors rather than running style.

watchPoints.text: Dragon Of Malta's fitness after 192 days off - if he weakens badly in the straight, it opens up the race completely
Whether any of the prominent racers (L L Koulsty, Send Harry, Smoke Them Out) apply early pressure to Dragon Of Malta
How quickly the hold-up horses (Gleneagle Bay, Mallavelly) begin their moves - they need to be traveling well turning for home
The apprentice jockeys' tactical decisions, particularly Sadhbh Tormey on Smoke Them Out and Max Popan on Dragon Of Malta
Goal Exceeded's position turning for home - has been running well recently and could benefit if the pace collapses

races.paceDynamic: Camelot Queen stands alone as the only confirmed front runner in this 13-runner maiden, meaning she can dictate terms from the front without pressure. With most of the field comprised of hold-up horses including Gaoth Chuil, Carmel's Phoenix, De Vega Queen, Mare Crisium, I Hope You Dance and Cosmetic, plus several unknown debutants, the early pace will be modest. Sangreal may sit prominent behind Camelot Queen, but the lack of early pace pressure means the leader can control sectionals perfectly. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will plague the large group of hold-up horses in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Camelot Queen Leads Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Camelot Queen breaks cleanly and faces no early pressure from the field
scenarios.body: She can dictate comfortable fractions and kick clear turning for home while the hold-up brigade get caught in traffic. The lack of pace pressure allows her to save energy for a decisive move when it matters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Debutant Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If one of the Harrington or O'Brien newcomers shows significant ability on debut
scenarios.body: The unknown quantities Walls Cross, Invincible Destiny, Tickle The Cat or Werifesteria could have been working well at home and spring a surprise. With quality trainers and jockeys engaged, they warrant respect despite their inexperience.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Navigation
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and allows a strong closer to weave through traffic
scenarios.body: One of the more experienced hold-up horses like Carmel's Phoenix or Gaoth Chuil could time their run perfectly despite the tactical disadvantage. The 1m4f trip gives them more time to make up ground than shorter distances would.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Sangreal can sit handy behind Camelot Queen and outkick her late
scenarios.body: The Joseph O'Brien runner showed promise when second on debut and could benefit from the perfect stalking trip. His RPR of 77 suggests he has more ability than most of these, and the prominent position avoids traffic issues.

watchPoints.text: Camelot Queen must break alertly from the stalls as any slow start would compromise her front-running tactics completely
Monitor the pace early as if Sangreal or any debutant shows more speed than expected it could pressure Camelot Queen
Watch for market moves on the Harrington newcomers Invincible Destiny and Werifesteria as stable money could be significant
Traffic problems likely in the straight given the high number of hold-up horses, watch for clear runs developing
Jockey bookings suggest Walls Cross and Tickle The Cat are less fancied than the other newcomers based on rider quality

races.paceDynamic: Magna Gee Gee will lead uncontested from the front, setting a manageable pace over this extended trip with no other confirmed front-runners in the 21-runner field. She's Ideal and Not Simple may press from prominent positions early, while Barretstown could also track close up, but the pace will be sustainable rather than searching. This setup creates a classic scenario where the lone leader can dictate terms, making life difficult for the large contingent of hold-up horses who will need to make ground from the back. The race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those who can track the early pace, as the hold-up horses face a significant disadvantage having to navigate traffic and make up ground late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Magna Gee Gee gets an easy lead and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: The unchallenged leader controls the race from the front and proves hard to peg back up the straight. The prominent runners struggle to get past her, while the hold-up horses are left with too much to do.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow for Magna Gee Gee to sustain her kick
scenarios.body: She's Ideal and Not Simple make their moves from tracking positions and have enough left to get past the fading leader. Their tactical positioning proves crucial as they avoid the traffic problems affecting the back-markers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the final quarter-mile
scenarios.body: One of the better-rated hold-up horses like Khormor Syd or Starting Monday finds a clear run and benefits from a strong finish. The early leaders pay for their efforts as the race becomes a sprint from the back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Magna Gee Gee stops badly and the prominent runners also empty
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with the entire field bunched together in the straight. An outsider from the hold-up ranks gets first run and steals the prize while the market leaders flounder.

watchPoints.text: Magna Gee Gee gets too easy a lead early and builds an unassailable advantage before the field can respond
The large field causes severe traffic problems in the straight, particularly affecting the hold-up horses
She's Ideal and Not Simple as the main prominent runners making their moves at the same time
Starting Monday as the only recent winner but facing a completely unsuitable pace scenario
Any early pace pressure on Magna Gee Gee from unexpected sources that could change the race dynamic
